headlines.title: World leaders speak at United Nations General Assembly
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as world leaders speak at the United Nations General Assembly. The gathering in New York comes as the world grapples with global issues including the economy, climate and conflicts in Iran and Ukraine.

headlines.title: Oil prices tumble to 2-week low on hopes for critical pipeline reopening and Iran diplomacy
headlines.description: Oil prices fell sharply fell for a fifth straight trading session, reaching a two-week low on hopes of a renewed diplomatic push to end the Iran war and optimism over the reopening of a critical pipeline in Saudi Arabia.

headlines.title: U.S. military leaders divided over action against the Houthis
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — U.S. military leaders are divided on whether President Donald Trump should get involved with the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Filmed in Captivity: Inside Russia’s Prison Propaganda Machine
headlines.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. The videos often haunt former captives long after their release. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

headlines.title: Rubio defends Trump’s banning media organizations, arguing there aren’t ‘soldiers kicking down the doors’ of the outlets
headlines.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the Trump administration’s decision to bar three media organizations from the White House, saying in an interview on NBC News’ “TODAY” that President Donald Trump was not closing outlets or arresting reporters.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere died from accidental drug overdose, including fentanyl, coroner says
headlines.description: “Heroes” and “Nashville” star Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled an accident caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, officials said Monday.

headlines.title: Poll: Most voters say Trump has hurt the economy as competitive midterm election looms
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s sinking ratings threaten to drag down Republicans in November’s midterm elections, as voters blame him for high prices and a shaky economy, according to a new NBC News poll.

headlines.title: Video Shows Aftermath of ICE Agent Shooting Driver in the Back
headlines.description: Protests erupted in Austin again on Monday night following the shooting of a Venezuelan delivery driver by an ICE agent. Video shows the moments officers surrounded 28-year-old Wilber Rafael Garcés Pérez after he was shot in the back.

headlines.title: No criminal charges in death of Nolan Wells, grand jury finds
headlines.description: A grand jury will not pursue criminal charges in the death of Nolan Wells, the local district attorney said, forcefully rejecting months of speculation that race played a role in the death of the Mississippi teen this summer.

headlines.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ influencer Clavicular charged with rape in Massachusetts
headlines.description: The “looksmaxxing” personality known as Clavicular has been charged with rape in Massachusetts, online court records show.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere died from accidental drug overdose, including fentanyl, coroner says
headlines.description: “Heroes” and “Nashville” star Hayden Panettiere’s death has been ruled an accident caused by the toxic effects of multiple drugs, including fentanyl, officials said Monday.

headlines.title: Climate scientists fired by Trump step in to fill U.S. report gap
headlines.description: More than a year after the Trump administration dismissed hundreds of scientists working on the National Climate Assessment, clouding the landmark publication’s future, many of those researchers and others released Tuesday the first installment of a special collection of climate change findings designed to fill the perceived gap left behind.
